Method of Attack: Spoofing vulnerability in Windows AppX Installer to deliver malware payloads
Using specially crafted Windows App Installer packages camouflaged as Adobe PDF software
Deploying malicious packages hosted on Microsoft Azure
Phishing campaigns with malicious attachments to convince users to open them
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of Windows AppX Installer spoofing vulnerability (CVE-2021-43890)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious Windows App Installer packages camouflaged as Adobe PDF software
